why: Analysis 1 offers a flagged hedgehog hypothesis (few front-drive platforms, no full line, a per-platform profit denominator) that tracks the key, plus a more actionable verdict and explicit succession warnings. Analysis 2 is tighter and better calibrated, since it gets the loss-year count right and avoids the extrapolated burn figure, but it declines to give a hedgehog and hands the leader less to act on.
